column5: Description
CO2: CO2 sensor
CO2 SP: CO2 setpoint
CONDITION: Unit operating mode
CLG 1 UNOCC SP: Room air temp stage 1 cooling setpoint, unoccupied
SOFTWARE CTRL SOURCE: Schedule control source (SCS)
HTG CTRL: Modulating heat control (gas furnace or electric heat)
HGRH CTRL: Modulating hot gas reheat control on leaving air temp
RAT HTG 1 UNOCC SP: Room air temp heating 1 setpoint, unoccupied
LAT HTG 2 SP: Leaving air temp stage 2 heating setpoint, occupied
LEAVING AIR TEMP: Leaving air temperature sensor
OA CLG 1 SP: Outside air temp stage 1 cooling setpoint
OA CLG 2 SP: Outside air temp stage 2 cooling setpoint
OA HTG 1 SP: Outside air temp stage 1 heating setpoint
CODENSER VALVE CTRL: Discharge valve control
OUTSIDE AIR RELATIVE HTY: Outside air relative humidity sensor
OUTSIDE AIR TEMP: Outside air temperature sensor
ROOM AIR RELATIVE HTY: Room air relative humidity sensor
ROOM CTRL OVERRIDE SP: Room control temp override setpoint (reheat and heat)
SF DPT: Supply fan differential pressure
SF DPT SP: Supply fan differential pressure setpoint
ZONE AIR TEMP: Room air temperature sensor
CODE OF ALARMS: Alarm code (see alarm code list)
DIGITAL COMP CTRL: Digital compressor control (DCC)
HGRH RAH SP DC CTRL: Room RH reheat setpoint for digital compressor control
HGRH RAH UNOCC SP: Room RH reheat setpoint, unoccupied
SF VFD Ctrl: Supply fan VFD output
LAT CLG OCC SP: Leaving air temp cooling setpoint, occupied
LAT CLG UNOCC SP: Leaving air temp cooling setpoint, unoccupied
LAT HGRH SP: Leaving air temp reheat setpoint, occupied
CLG 2 UNOCC SP: Room air temp stage 2 cooling setpoint, unoccupied
DAMPER MIN OPEN: Damper minimum % open
ECONOMIZER CTRL: Economizer control (ECON)
RAT HTG 2 UNOCC SP: Room air temp heating 2 setpoint, unoccupied
SUCTION LINE TEMP Y1= OFF SP: Suction line temp setpoint for compressor 1 (Y1)
SUCTION LINE TEMP DC=10 SP: Suction line temp setpoint, digital scroll Y1 at 10%
SUCTION LINE TEMP: Suction line temperature sensor
OA ENTPY: Outside air enthalpy value
OA ENTPY CLG SP: Outside air enthalpy cooling setpoint
OA ENTPY HTG SP: Outside air enthalpy heating setpoint
RA ENTPY: Room air enthalpy value
WARM UP HTG SP: Room air temp warm-up heating setpoint
UNIT OPERATION FROM BAS: Building automation system control
SF CMD: Supply fan relay command (BR)
ALARM SOUND ACTIVATION: Alarm sound activation command
COMP 1 CMD: Compressor 1 start command
COMP 2 CMD: Compressor 2 start command
HEATING 2 CMD: Heat 2 start command
REHEAT CMD: Hot gas reheat solenoid valve relay command (RHR)
ROOM CTRL OVERRIDE ENABLE: Room control temp override (reheat) activation
NIGHT SET BACK ENABLE: Night setback activation
OD / EF / WM / WD CMD: Exhaust fan, wheel, outside damper command
HEATING 1 CMD: Heat 1 start command
